::: {.hl-panel .page-head}
# Your documents are read on this PC. The AI is never given an outside address to send them to.

This page shows what runs where, the proof we have, what we have **not** proven yet, and a draft paragraph you could
adapt for your office's [written security plan](glossary.qmd#wisp){.gl}. It makes no claim that the tool makes anyone
compliant with any rule.
:::

::: {.hl-panel .chapter}
## What runs where

```{=html}
<div class="where" role="list">
  <section class="where-box is-pc" role="listitem" aria-labelledby="w-pc">
    <h3 id="w-pc">On this PC <span class="where-tag">✓ your documents stay here</span></h3>
    <ol class="flow">
      <li><b>Your PDF files</b><span>in a folder you choose</span></li>
      <li><b>Text reader</b><span>pypdf pulls the text out of each PDF</span></li>
      <li><b>The AI model</b><span>{{< var run.model >}}, running in Ollama at <code>localhost:11434</code></span></li>
      <li><b>Automatic checks</b><span>a real date, a known category, a sensible number; up to 3 tries</span></li>
      <li><b>Finished tables</b><span>DuckDB file and CSV files for Excel or Power BI</span></li>
    </ol>
  </section>
  <section class="where-box is-net" role="listitem" aria-labelledby="w-net">
    <h3 id="w-net">The internet <span class="where-tag">only for these</span></h3>
    <ul class="flow plain">
      <li><b>Once, at setup</b><span>downloading Ollama and the AI model file (about 3.3 GB)</span></li>
      <li><b>Demo only: public recalls</b><span>1 FDA web page and the NHTSA recalls API, cached after the first run. Never your documents. <code>--offline</code> turns it off.</span></li>
    </ul>
    <h3 class="where-none">Cloud AI services <span class="where-tag">none used</span></h3>
    <p>No ChatGPT, no Copilot, no API key, no account.</p>
  </section>
</div>
```
:::

::: {.hl-panel .chapter}
## The proof we have

**1. The code refuses outside addresses.** Before it sends any text, the reading program checks where it is sending it.
Anything other than [localhost](glossary.qmd#localhost){.gl} stops the program with an error.

{{< include _gen/guard.html >}}

**2. The test suite ran and passed** on {{< var run.date >}}: {{< var run.pytest >}}, including the test above.

**3. The AI model does not learn from your files.** Ollama runs a fixed model file; reading a document does not change
it. The program does keep a cache of the AI's answers on disk (`data/llm_cache/`), so a re-run is instant. That cache
holds extracted values and belongs in your retention plan.
:::

::: {.hl-panel .chapter .limits}
## What we have not proven yet

- **No network capture.** Nobody has yet recorded the PC's network traffic during a run to show zero outside connections.
  That is the next test.
- **Not tested on an air-gapped PC** (one with no network at all), although nothing in the design needs one.
- **Only SYNTHETIC documents.** It has never been run on real client files.
- **No [OCR](glossary.qmd#ocr){.gl}.** It reads PDFs that already contain text. Scans and faxes would need an extra step.
- **Not a security product.** It cannot protect files that are already exposed elsewhere on the PC.
:::

::: {.hl-panel .chapter #wisp}
## Draft wording for your written security plan

[Draft wording, not legal advice]{.tag .tag-draft}

Tax preparers must keep a [WISP](glossary.qmd#wisp){.gl} under the [FTC Safeguards Rule](glossary.qmd#safeguards-rule){.gl}
([IRS Publication 5708](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p5708.pdf) is a free template). Law firms weigh
[ABA Formal Opinion 512](glossary.qmd#aba-512){.gl}. The paragraph below only describes this tool. Fill in the brackets,
and have the person responsible for your plan, or your adviser, review it. It is not a complete plan.

```{=html}
<div class="wisp">
<p id="wisp-text">[Firm name] uses Local AI Document Reader on [computer name] to copy facts from [document types] into
spreadsheets. The program and its AI model run entirely on that computer. Document text is sent only to a service on the
same computer (localhost); the program is written to refuse any other address, and this is checked by an automated test.
No cloud AI service is used and no account is required. The internet is used only to install the program and download the
AI model; document processing does not require it. Source documents, extracted data and the program's answer cache are
stored in [folder], which is covered by the access controls, encryption, backup and disposal procedures in section [X] of
this plan. Cached answers are deleted [schedule]. The AI model does not learn from or keep our documents. [Staff role]
reviews every extracted value before it is used, and the tool never files or submits anything on its own.</p>
<button type="button" class="btn-ghost" id="wisp-copy" data-target="wisp-text">Copy this paragraph</button>
<span id="wisp-copied" class="muted" aria-live="polite"></span>
</div>
```

::: {.wtm}
**Why the brackets matter.** Only your office knows where files live, who reviews them and how long they are kept.
The tool can help you describe it in your plan; it does not make your office compliant by itself.
:::
:::
